tools.description: Read one repository file and return its complete text. Errors when the path does not exist.

path.description: The file's path relative to the repository root, e.g. src/lib.rs.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Replace one repository file's complete text (or create it). Always send the whole file.

path.description: The file's path relative to the repository root.

content.description: The complete new text of the file.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run the crate's test suite and return the runner's report. The first line is run_tests: PASS or run_tests: FAIL. The runner stops at the first failing test and reports only that assertion; later tests run only once it passes.
